description: This file implements a stateless text transformation processor for the Pipecat framework, which applies user-defined transformation functions to text frames within a processing pipeline.

classes.name: StatelessTextTransformer
classes.description: A processor that intercepts TextFrame objects and applies a user-specified transformation function, which can be synchronous or asynchronous, to the text content.

methods.name: __init__( self, transform_fn: Union[Callable[[str], str], Callable[[str], Coroutine[None, None, str]]] )
methods.description: Initializes the StatelessTextTransformer with a transformation function, which can be either synchronous or asynchronous.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes a frame, applying the transformation function if the frame is a TextFrame, and pushes the result downstream.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, transform_fn: Union[Callable[[str], str], Callable[[str], Coroutine[None, None, str]]] )

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/
